operation.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Update an existing invoice payment.

This is a partial update — send only the fields you want to change, under an `InvoicePayment` object. Fields not listed below (and any read-only fields) are ignored.

**Editable fields** (for payments recorded by staff/API): `amount`, `date`, `payment_method`, `transaction_id`, `treasury_id`, `status`, `notes`, `receipt_notes`, `currency_code`, `staff_id`, `invoice_id`, `extra_details`, `attachment`. If the payment was recorded by a client, only a narrower set is editable: `treasury_id`, `receipt_notes`, `status`, `notes`, `invoice_id`, `attachment`.

Notes: `payment_method`, if changed, must be one of the account's active configured methods (changing it clears stored gateway metadata). Changing the payment `date` requires the relevant permission; otherwise the original date is kept.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric reference of the invoice payment to update.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response format suffix appended to the path, e.g. `.json`.

InvoicePayment.description: The fields to change. All optional — only the supplied editable fields are updated.

date.description: Payment date, in the account's date format. Requires the change-payment-date permission to take effect.

payment_method.description: Payment method. Must be one of the account's active configured methods. Changing it clears stored gateway metadata.

treasury_id.description: Treasury the payment is deposited into.

status.description:
Payment status.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Not completed |
| 1 | Completed |
| 2 | Pending |
| 3 | Failed |
| 4 | Overpaid |
| 5 | Draft |

notes.description: Internal notes on the payment (max 500 characters).

receipt_notes.description: Notes shown on the payment receipt.

staff_id.description: Staff member associated with the payment.

invoice_id.description: Reference of the invoice the payment is applied to.

extra_details.description: Additional gateway / processing metadata, as a JSON-encoded string.

attachment.description: Attachment reference(s); comma-separated when more than one.

400.description: The update failed validation (e.g. an unsupported payment method or notes over 500 characters).

validation_errors.description: Per-field error messages keyed by the attribute that failed.

403.description: The authenticated user lacks permission to edit this payment.

404.description: No invoice payment matches the supplied id.
